title: The Frontier of Spatial Intelligence with Fei-Fei Li

reader_summary.headline: This is fundamentally, philosophically, to be a different problem.
reader_summary.overview: This is fundamentally, philosophically, to be a different problem. The previous decade had mostly been about understanding data that already exists. But the next decade was going to be about understanding new data. Visual, spatial intelligence is so fundamental.

key_points.text: It is like unwrapping presents on Christmas, that every day you know there's going to be some amazing new discovery.
key_points.evidence_quote: It is like unwrapping presents on Christmas, that every day you know there's going to be some amazing new discovery, some amazing new application or algorithm somewhere.

key_points.text: If we see something, or if we imagine something, Both can converge towards generating it.
key_points.evidence_quote: If we see something, or if we imagine something, Both can converge towards generating it.

key_points.text: I think we're in the middle of a Cambrian explosion.
key_points.evidence_quote: I think we're in the middle of a Cambrian explosion.

key_points.text: To many, the last two years of AI have felt like a light switch, pre-imposed GPT3.
key_points.evidence_quote: To many, the last two years of AI have felt like a light switch, pre-imposed GPT3, pre-imposed being able to generate an image with natural language, and even pre-imposed translating any video with the click of a button.

thesis: The speakers describe the current era of artificial intelligence as a 'Cambrian explosion' where the technology has evolved from understanding existing data to generating new data across text, pixels, video, and audio. They characterize this transition as a continuation of a multi-decade continuum that is now destined to proceed into the physical and spatial world.
